Department of Urban Forestry
The Urban Forestry Graduate Program offers an advanced educational opportunity for students interested in major environmental issues through green infrastructure, technology, and management applications.
One of the program's strengths is its emphasis on experiential learning and hands-on fieldwork. Students have the opportunity to participate in research projects, internships, and field trips, gaining practical experience and applying classroom concepts to real-world situations. Additionally, students benefit from collaboration with faculty members who are actively engaged in research and outreach efforts related to urban forestry.
The Southern University and A&M College Urban Forestry Graduate Program also offers a supportive and inclusive learning environment. Faculty members are committed to mentorship and personalized guidance, helping students tailor their educational experience to their career goals and interests. Additionally, the program values diversity and encourages the participation of students from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.
Upon completion of the program, graduates are well-prepared for careers in various sectors including municipal government, environmental consulting, nonprofit organizations, and academia. They possess the knowledge, skills, and practical experience needed to effectively manage urban forests, promote sustainability, and enhance the quality of life in urban communities.
